claims.statement: Figma's OAuth apps documentation describes a refresh token returned in the initial token exchange response as refresh_token, which can be reused as many times as necessary at POST /v1/oauth/refresh to obtain a replacement access token.

sources.supports: A refresh token can be reused as many times as necessary to obtain a replacement access token.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Candidate only: the page shows only a <REFRESH TOKEN> placeholder and states no prefix, alphabet, length or other format. Not researched beyond existence; no format is inferred.
